detailed_findings.finding: The proof correctly justifies that each graded piece is finite-dimensional because all weights are positive, so the Hilbert series manipulations are legitimate as formal power series.

reason: The proof gives the standard complete Hilbert-series argument for a homogeneous regular sequence in a positively weighted polynomial ring. It verifies finite-dimensionality of graded pieces, computes Hilb_S(q)=1/\prod_i(1-q^{w_i}), constructs for each i the exact sequence 0 -> M_{i-1}(-e_i) -> M_{i-1} -> M_i -> 0 using the non-zero-divisor property of g_i, deduces Hilb_{M_i}(q)=(1-q^{e_i})Hilb_{M_{i-1}}(q), and iterates to obtain the claimed formula. The proof matches the lemma sketch and role in the assembly, with no semantic drift or dependency issues.
